recommendation: Keep the published fix. The RelativeTime datatype structure and later EventDefinition refinement are otherwise applied; this correction removes the remaining canonical metadata defect in the value set used by RelativeTime.contextCode.
issue_request: FHIR-41582 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested a TimeFromEvent datatype, resolved as the new RelativeTime datatype with contextReference, contextDefinition, contextPath, contextCode, offset[x], text, and invariants; the resolution specifically called for RelativeTime.contextCode to have an example binding to Evidence Variable Event.
initial_application: Commit 86dc727207 created RelativeTime and registered it in source/fhir.ini. Current source/fhir.ini keeps RelativeTime active, source/datatypes/relativetime.xml defines the requested elements/invariants, and the contextCode binding points to RelativeTimeCodes via valueset-relativetime-codes. Later commit e225678eb9 added valueset-relativetime-codes.xml with copied price-component-type canonical URL and work-group metadata.
additional_context: FHIR-53409 later and intentionally added EventDefinition to RelativeTime.contextDefinition, so that current-source difference from the original FHIR-41582 resolution is correct. FHIR-50530 later clarified RelativeTime wording without changing the contextCode binding. FHIR-41513 was resolved no-change because separate trackers covered the datatype and uses. FHIR-50586 is Resolved - change required rather than Applied/Published and concerns rendered constraints boxes, so it was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/valueset-relativetime-codes.xml to use canonical http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/relativetime-codes and the FHIR Infrastructure work-group code fhir, preserving the existing example code composition.
source_changes: source/datatypes/valueset-relativetime-codes.xml: changed the structuredefinition-wg extension from pa to fhir.
